businesses.business: heart valves and hemodynamic monitoring devices

offering_description.value: Designs and makes heart valve replacement and repair products and hemodynamic monitoring systems for hospitals. Sells mainly to cardiac surgeons, interventional cardiologists and hospital critical care teams, through a direct sales force and some distributors.

primary_products.value: transcatheter heart valves; surgical heart valves; hemodynamic monitoring systems; surgical repair products

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, cardiac surgery centers, cardiology and catheterization labs

revenue_model.value: product sales: implantable heart valves and monitoring equipment and disposables sold to hospitals

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes valves and monitors from purchased tissue, polymers and components, sold to hospitals and distributors; brand owner: designs and markets its own branded medical devices to physicians and hospital buyers

geography_served.value: global: US, Europe, Japan and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: heart valve therapies, surgical valve products and hemodynamic monitoring for cardiac care

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and clinical specialists calling on hospitals and cardiac centers; distributors / dealers: independent distributors in some international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: implantable heart valves and monitoring devices need FDA premarket approval and CE marking
